title: RadoRecords: SAT witnesses and machine-checked refutations for the 2-color Rado numbers
description: Computational evidence for terms a(31)-a(60) of OEIS A250026, the 2-color Rado numbers of x_1^2 + x_2^2 + ... + x_n^2 = z^2. Lower bounds are explicit colorings checked by a standard-library-only program that never invokes a solver; upper bounds are SAT refutations certified with drat-trim, computed under two independent encodings that must agree at every instance. Includes the verification gate that re-derives every claim from the committed artifacts, and the pre-paste linter the OEIS submissions were checked with.
